messages:
Maya Iyer: FYI there's a reconciliation alert: billed tokens for streaming endpoints higher than request logs for Nov 30 evening window. Need eng + billing to triage.
Liam Chen: which customers/time window?
Maya Iyer: Customers: VectorLabs and TruSense. Window: 20:02:10 - 20:18:30 UTC. Invoices 2025-11-30-VEC and 2025-11-30-TRU.
Omar Saleh: I can look. Suspect streaming finalize events not always emitted when connection resets; billing currently counts both ingest and finalize in some flows which could double-count.
Priya Rao: if finalize is missing we should use ingest as canonical, but only once. Do we have request_id dedupe for streaming?
Liam Chen: streaming path sets request_id at session open, but we saw a bug where some client disconnects caused router to emit a proxy_reconnect event with a new ephemeral id, leading billing to see two request_ids and count twice.
billing-bot: [automated] billing-runner job 2025-11-30-20:30 flagged high delta between ingress_tokens and billing_tokens for route /v1/stream/generate
Maya Iyer: can we quantify per-customer delta so Finance can prepare credits? Also need to know if any single credit > $500.
Liam Chen: running join now: request_logs -> billing_events grouped by customer. Will upload CSV.
Omar Saleh: quick check: VectorLabs delta ~186,700 tokens. TruSense delta ~612,400 tokens (whoa).
Priya Rao: TruSense is on custom enterprise tier with blended rate ~$0.00095/1k. 612.4k -> 612.4 * 0.00095 = $581.78. That's > $500 so VP approval required.
Maya Iyer: note that. Finance hold TruSense invoice until formal approval. For VectorLabs we can auto-credit if < $500.
Liam Chen: CSV uploaded: /shared/finance/reconciliations/1771206789-streaming-audit.csv with columns: customer, route, billed_tokens, unique_stream_tokens, delta_tokens.
Omar Saleh: root cause: router emits session_reconnect event on transient network hiccup which currently creates a new internal request id. I'll push a patch to propagate original session id on reconnects. Test & hotfix ETA 3h.
Priya Rao: meanwhile we should run a backfill recalculation for Nov 30 streaming billables and produce dry-run numbers. Liam, can you run dry-run and drop results?
Liam Chen: dry-run scheduled now (idempotency token set). Will post results in ~20m.
support-bot: [automated] Support ticket #34892 opened for TruSense: "Billing discrepancy 2025-11-30" (assigned to Jenna Park)
Maya Iyer: Priya prepare the VP approval request packet for TruSense (include CSV evidence, root cause, mitigation timeline, customer impact). We'll need sign-off before applying credit >$500.
Priya Rao: on it. Drafting now and will include estimated credit $581.78 and note that fix will prevent recurrence.
Liam Chen: dry-run done. Corrected tokens: VectorLabs corrected delta = 186,700 -> $158.36. TruSense corrected delta = 612,400 -> $581.78. Dry-run output saved: /shared/finance/reconciliations/1771206789-dryrun-results.csv
Maya Iyer: Action items: (1) Omar push session-id hotfix and ensure reconnect preserves id (2) Liam apply backfill once VP approves TruSense credit (3) Priya prepare VP packet and credit memos (4) Support send provisional notice to customers.
Omar Saleh: hotfix pushed to canary, unit tests added. Rollout to prod pending approval.
Maya Iyer: Finance will hold TruSense invoice and proceed with VectorLabs auto-credit. Priya, confirm credit memo language.
Priya Rao: sending VectorLabs credit memo now. For TruSense I'll attach VP packet in ~30m.
Maya Iyer: thanks all. Closing thread when backfill applied and VP sign-off recorded. :white_check_mark:
